annotations.title: Assign or move a stay's room

description: Changes: assigns one stay a room, or moves it to another; any price difference is shown in the preview and accepted only at that figure. Previews first: the first call shows the change and makes nothing. Assigns a room to a stay, or moves it. First call without confirm: a preview (any price difference), nothing changes; then call again with the same values, confirm true and preview_id. A room out of order or taken is refused; a stay booked on Expedia or Booking.com moves only to a room of its own type. Needs the owner's sign-in.

confirm.description: true to go ahead with the change shown in the preview
